programs.title: Dog Patrol
programs.desc: A story about dogs who, together with their guardians, maintain order in New Zealand prisons, belong to customs teams and other formations.Viewers will see how officers cooperate with animals that help fight crime and protect borders.Luke and Ice are a canine duo from Wellington who tracked down a drunk driver.Wally prevents prohibited items from being brought into the prison.Yarra, on the other hand, is extremely effective at detecting drugs.
